notes: The stats panel's lines by kind (0x03cbc3, the flags at 0x17bf3c): level (beside LIGHT, NORMAL or HEAVY; no word for CHIPs), weight and capacity in tonnes (the records keep hundredths), armour (a body's or legs' never below the player's floor, 0x03c5e2), sockets (a body's socket holes, 0x0bb0c8), speed, jump, ammo, rounds and damage (a weapon's, never below the record's minimum), recharge (a beam's, battle ticks at 30 a second), module_sockets (the sockets a module takes), active_time and charge_time (the O.C times in display frames, 60 a second) and laser_reduction (shown instead of the O.C times by a module that cuts lasers).
decimals are the original's (0x0bc769 draws the fraction, the point, then the whole part, right to left); lines with none drop the fraction.
full_price: the modules a shop buys back at their whole price (0x022ea6: the Gold Bar, module 45).

extras: stats the panel's art prints no line for, shown below its lines only when not 0 (a port addition): a module's critical chance (+0x14, the CHIP shop's MORTAL SHOT) and knockdown resistance (+0x18). Sources: critical_percent, knockdown_resistance (modules, CHIPs), dodge_percent (CHIPs), knockback_resistance (legs). Every leg has a knockback resistance, so a leg's panel always has a line more than the art's; the shops fit it above the CURRENT MUSIC plate (data/ui/module_shop.json extra_stats part_raise and part_step).

details: a second page of the weapons' panel (a port addition, left and right turn to it): what the record gives the battle (apply_weapon_stats), lines at 0 left out. fire_rate: shots a second (none for a beam, which is held), range: the farthest the computer fires it at (weapon_reach), shot_speed: a round's top speed or a beam tip's, spread: degrees between a burst's rounds, homing: a missile's turn a second, blast_radius and blast_damage, stun: the target's flinch, knockback: the push a hit gives, knockdown: a critical hit's chance to knock off a weapon. World units read as metres. The weapons' extras line, weapon_type, letters the type data/ui/weapon_types.json names.
